notes.title: New update available!
notes.content:
⦁ With a 60% chance a random Boss will appear in a random area after finding a Severely Infected.

⦁ In a random area from midnight to 6 am there will be a maximum of infected.
Keep this in mind if you need experience or resources.

⦁ Added some achievements.

notes.title: New update available!
notes.content:
⦁ Now all weapons have states.
The states change and give a bonus to damage when upgrading weapons.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35137860/129c6304017203b4d880b11986c1879fdbc82259.jpg[/img]
states:
ordinary 1lvl+
improved 5lvl+
reliable 10lvl+
perfect 15lvl+

⦁ Improved bow damage calculation formula.

⦁ Added new sound to change weapon states.
